note: Team-chosen targets, not Ryde's. Ryde's own baseline is the brief's 24–72 hours per dispute; the figures below are what this queue measures itself against, and this file is the only place they are stated. Changing one changes what `python3 -m ops.queue` reports as due and as breached, and nothing else in the repository reads this file.

evidence_window.note: OPS-EW-01, an operations rule and not frozen policy. The reviewer opens the window within POL-GEN-06(2)'s 24 hours of entry; the window closes close_hours_after_filing hours after filing, and the decision is due at POL-GEN-06(2)'s first-review limit. A missing piece of evidence never stops the clock. `python3 -m ops.evidence_window` reads this figure and refuses when it is absent.
